card.name: Words inside past-tense clauses
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of a past-tense clause, after had, was or an earlier past event, where a past verb or its object has just appeared. Fires on a verb participle, a noun, or a number before the clause ends.

modes.label: After past auxiliary
modes.description: A participle or object following had/were/been in narrative past text.

modes.label: Inside a number
modes.description: The start of a number such as 48 or 46 in a results sentence reporting outcomes.
